en:
## New Features

- Unify session workspaces and permission requests, with directory switching, worktree management, and safer local and remote execution.
- Open resources in a full-height right-side drawer by default, with adjacent-pane pinning and one-click split views.
- Browse historical Git commits and open commit details in independent preview windows.
- Clarify queued, immediate guidance, and urgent guidance messages; switch modes inline and edit queued messages by double-clicking.
- Inspect context composition using cached character counts without rescanning message bodies.
- Prepare sessions for recovery and gracefully shut down, then resume unfinished work after a manual restart.
- Let agents send authorized notifications to selected users through DingTalk and Feishu.
- Preserve sender identities across current messages, history, and compressed context.
- Support safe remote structural editing and native conditional file replacement on Windows and macOS.
- Expand browser diagnostics with memory metrics, heap snapshots, allocation sampling, and garbage-collection analysis.

## Improvements

- Improve long-conversation rendering, live text wrapping during resizing, and bounded previews with in-place expansion.
- Keep reading positions and session state stable across responsive layout changes while reducing unnecessary renders.
- Improve mobile Director layouts, keyboard behavior, touch reading, tab dragging, and file-tree icons.
- Separate Browser and WebFetch proxy settings and improve executor installation and refresh workflows.
- Retire the obsolete file-change panel while preserving approvals, rollback, and compatibility with saved layouts.

## Bug Fixes

- Prevent large streamed Write inputs from freezing the interface while retaining full highlighting, copying, and search.
- Fix latest-first search ordering, short-keyword search, cancellation, and search-provider fallback validation; move SQLite searches to read-only workers.
- Fix blank share previews and support streamed audio/video, safe HTML, text, and PDF previews.
- Improve Codex authorization error handling, proxy guidance, reserved-port avoidance on Windows, and manual callbacks.
- Fix workspace rollback boundaries, storage-failure detection, and plan-approval compatibility.
- Restore queued-message sender and attachment previews, localized send buttons, and discussion/private-chat bubble layouts.
- Unify desktop and mobile settings navigation and restore missing gateway, device, and execution-log entries.
- Fix Git previews for file-type changes and links under subpath deployments.
- Harden collaborative task result handoff, notification deduplication, PostgreSQL support, and plugin communication limits.
- Bound model-catalog update downloads and allow large release uploads within the production server budget.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 统一普通会话的工作区与权限申请，支持切换目录、管理工作树及更安全的本地和远程执行。
- 资源默认在全高右侧抽屉打开，支持固定到邻格与一键右侧分屏，减少对现有布局的挤占。
- 支持浏览 Git 历史提交，并在独立预览窗口查看提交详情。
- 明确排队、即时引导和紧急引导语义，支持行内切换模式及双击编辑排队消息。
- 新增上下文组成查看器，使用缓存字符统计，避免重复扫描消息正文。
- 支持准备恢复与优雅关闭，手动重新启动后可续跑未完成工作。
- 支持 agent 经授权向指定用户发送钉钉或飞书通知。
- 为当前消息、历史和压缩上下文统一保留发送者身份。
- 支持安全远程结构编辑，以及 Windows、macOS 原生条件文件替换。
- 扩展浏览器诊断，新增内存指标、堆快照、分配采样和自然垃圾回收分析。

## 体验优化

- 优化长会话渲染与调整宽度时的实时换行，长文本支持有界预览和原位展开。
- 响应式布局切换保留阅读位置与会话状态，减少聊天主体和弹窗的无关渲染。
- 改善移动端导播台布局、软键盘交互、触摸阅读、标签拖拽及文件树类型图标。
- 拆分 Browser 与 WebFetch 代理配置，完善执行器安装、手动回退和刷新流程。
- 移除失效的文件修改面板，保留审批、回退及已保存布局的兼容能力。

## 修复

- 修复超长 Write 流式输入导致界面卡死，保留完整高亮、复制和搜索能力。
- 修复搜索最新排序、短词搜索、取消与渠道回退验证，并将 SQLite 搜索移至只读 worker。
- 修复分享预览空白，支持流式音视频及安全 HTML、文本和 PDF 预览。
- 完善 Codex 授权失败提示与代理引导，避开 Windows 保留端口并支持手动回调。
- 修复工作区回退边界、磁盘故障误判及计划人工审批兼容性。
- 恢复排队消息发送人和附件直显、发送按钮中英文适配，并修复讨论与私聊气泡布局。
- 统一桌面与手机设置导航，补齐网关、设备和执行日志入口。
- 修复文件类型变化的 Git 差异预览及子路径部署链接。
- 加固协作任务结果交接、通知去重、PostgreSQL 支持及插件通信预算。
- 限制模型目录更新下载大小，并完善生产更新服务器的大体积发布包上传支持。
